name: baseline
description: WHD Next 3.0 firewall baseline (same values as WHD Next 2.0). Firewall menu A or Invoke-WHDApplyFirewallProfile. Starts SAFE: default-deny outbound is off until you set it to true. IPv6 suppressed (::1 loopback kept). DNS rules pinned to Cloudflare 1.1.1.2 / 1.0.0.2 (malware filter; menu D sets the resolver + encrypted DoH). HTTP / HTTPS open to any address. Block lists are your own files in this folder (not shipped).

allowList.name: WHDN-Allow-DHCP-Out
allowList.displayName: WHD Next Allow DHCP request (UDP out 68->67)

allowList.name: WHDN-Allow-DHCP-In
allowList.displayName: WHD Next Allow DHCP reply (UDP in <-67)

_notes: Strict: set defaultDenyOutbound to true - everything outbound is blocked except this allow-list. A scheduled task (WHDN-DefaultDenyRollback, runs Windows' netsh) switches outbound back to Allow after rollbackMinutes unless you confirm with menu 7.
NTP: when Windows Time points at time.cloudflare.com, the NTP rule is narrowed to Cloudflare's time addresses.

IP block list: blacklist-ip.txt in this folder (WHD Next 2.0's list is copied here once). It follows the firewall: block rules go in only where something is wide open. Private, multicast and reserved ranges are never blocked.
Domains: blocked at the resolver (menu D). The hosts sinkhole (menu H, blacklist-hosts.txt) is NOT part of this baseline; add "hostsFile": "blacklist-hosts.txt" under blacklist to include it.
Another resolver: change both DNS remoteAddress lists here AND the DNS settings at the top of WHDNext\Features\Firewall.ps1.
